source.title: Irish News, 18 May 1949, p. 3 ("Rural council nominations in the North")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the 21 electoral divisions of Coleraine rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. The Irish News prints the full nomination list of 18 May. Twenty members were nominated unopposed and Aghadowey had two nominations, but Workman's was declared invalid, so there was no poll. Aghadowey was not polled after all: Matthew Workman's nomination was declared invalid, leaving W. J. Anderson returned unopposed (Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1949, p. 6); Somerset, with no nomination, returned its retiring member John Henry as deemed re-elected (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
